CARICOM Trade and Investment Facilitation Framework

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Business Companies Act, Chapter 270 (Revised Edition 2020), sections 12–18; Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act, Chapter 105 (as amended); International Business Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations; Money Laundering (Lower Risk Designation) Rules; Belize Companies Registry AML/CFT Operational Guidance 2024.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified True Copy of Passport of Each UBO, Shareholder, Director and Authorized Signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National Passport Office / Notary Public in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for foreign documents; notarization in Belize for domestic documents

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of Residential Address (Utility Bill or Bank Statement, Issued Within the Last 90 Days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility Provider or International Banking Institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and Hague Apostille / Consular Legalization where the issuer is non-Apostille

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter from a Viable International Financial Institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization or Hague Apostille as mandated by the receiving registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Name Reservation / Pre-Incorporation Clearance Memorandum
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille through Belize Supreme Court Registry for foreign use; in-country transmission to registered agent

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, shareholders and authorized signatories against: (i) PEP databases; (ii) OFAC SDN list; (iii) UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (iv) Belize domestic counter-terrorism list; and (v) CARICOM terrorism and organized crime lists. Enhanced due diligence (EDD) is required upon any PEP indicator, non-resident high-risk jurisdiction exposure, or unexplained wealth pattern. Ongoing transaction and adverse-media monitoring is mandated under the Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act, Chapter 105.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: International Business Companies Registry, Belize Companies Registry, Government of Belize (online filing via https://www.companiesregistry.gov.bz)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All proposed names must be submitted in English or accompanied by a certified English transliteration. The name may contain only letters A–Z, Arabic numerals, and must end with a statutory suffix (e.g., Limited, Limited Liability, Ltd., Incorporated, Inc., Corporation, Corp., or analogous statutory abbreviation). Special characters, slashes, dashes, ampersands, and punctuation are disallowed unless necessary for legal identity. The name must not be misleading, impractical, or identical/confusingly similar to an existing registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may file a written representation to the Registrar of Companies within 14 calendar days of the date of the refusal notice. The representation must include the desired name, supporting justification, and a non-refundable review fee. If the Registrar upholds the rejection, the applicant may submit an amended name or escalate to the Minister responsible for financial services for a discretionary reconsideration. Only after exhausting these administrative remedies may judicial review be sought before the Supreme Court of Belize.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible by statute for the IBC registered office. Each IBC must continuously maintain a physical registered office in Belize at the address of its licensed registered agent. A virtual office may be utilised for non-statutory business support and administrative functions, but it must not be held out as the registered office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low. Baseline annual probability of unannounced Government or registered-agent-led physical inspection is less than 5% for a purely digital publishing entity. The risk increases to approximately 15-20% if the entity is flagged for PEP involvement, sanctions screening anomalies, or targeted AML/CFT supervisory review.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Business Companies Act, Chapter 270 of the Laws of Belize (as amended), particularly sections 4 (incorporation), 6 (memorandum and articles), 7 (registration), 10 (certificate of incorporation), and 11 (registered office and directors).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry, Belize City, Belize
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (IBC statutory registration form)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed. An IBC may be incorporated with shares of no par value, and issued shares may remain unpaid until a director calls for payment. There is no statutory escrow account or paid-up capital deposit requirement at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the draft Articles of Incorporation presented to this meeting are adopted and directed to be filed with the Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry of Belize. RESOLVED, that the subscription for 1,000 common shares of no par value by the founding shareholder is approved, and such shares are hereby issued. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company shall be located at the address of its licensed registered agent in Belize City, Belize. RESOLVED, that [Director] is appointed as director, and that the director is authorized to execute all filings and pay the required government fee. FURTHER RESOLVED, that upon issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation, all officers are authorized to establish the statutory corporate records and open bank accounts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage a licensed Belize registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent approved by the Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry of Belize
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Select a Belize-licensed registered agent, execute a registered-office agreement, and submit the corporate KYC/AML package. The agent drafts the Articles of Incorporation and arranges payment of the government incorporation fee.
required_dossiers: Passport copy and utility bill of each shareholder and director
If corporate shareholder exists: certificate of incorporation and register of directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the KYC or beneficial ownership information is incomplete, cure by filing notarized confirmations and updated due-diligence forms within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare and notarize the Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent and a Belize notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent prepares the Articles of Incorporation specifying the authorized capital, registered office, object clause, and intended activities. Review by the founder and local notary for execution before submission.
required_dossiers: Name approval certificate if a preferred name was reserved
Consent of the first director to act
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Articles contain defects, amend the document to comply with the International Business Companies Act and re-execute before a Belize notary without losing the original submission date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit the incorporation file to the Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry, Belize City
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files the Articles of Incorporation together with the prescribed government fee and any statutory declarations. The Registry examines the file and issues a status update.
required_dossiers: Signed and notarized Articles of Incorporation
Payment receipt for the government incorporation fee
Consent of registered agent and first director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a query, correct any typographical inconsistency or capital clause defect and resubmit the corrected Articles, usually with a shorter priority review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the Registry approves the file, the Certificate of Incorporation and the certified copy of the Articles are issued. The registered agent retrieves the originals and prepares the statutory corporate documents.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains errors in the company name or date, file a rectification application with the Registry within 30 days accompanied by the original certificate and supporting affidavit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establish the statutory registered office and corporate records
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Maintain the registered office in Belize City as required by law. Open the statutory share register, minutes ledger, corporate seal, and shareholder register, and record the first issuance of shares.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any statutory register is incomplete, prepare a supplementary board resolution and back-dated register entries consistent with the IBC Act; no public filing is required for internal books.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adopt the first board resolution and complete post-incorporation organizational governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company's first board of directors through the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or adopt unanimous written resolutions covering share subscription, appointment of officers, adoption of the registered office, and approval of the corporate bank account signatories. Update the company minutes and distribute appointed director/officer consents.
required_dossiers: Minutes or written resolutions of the first board meeting
Consent of each director and officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a director or officer declines appointment, appoint a substitute officer by written resolution and notify the registered agent; no amendment to the public Articles is required for an officer-only change.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable to a virtual-only digital publishing business. Belize does not mandate any industrial or sectoral license for ISIC 5820 software/console publishing. If a physical office is opened later, the Belize Town and Country Planning Department and the Belize Building Authority regulate occupancy.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operating license or manufacturing permit is required for PC and console video game publishing via Steam or PlayStation Store under the current Belize IBC framework.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Belize Department of the Environment (DOE), Ministry of Sustainable Development, Climate Change and Disaster Risk Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — purely digital/electronic service activity with no physical manufacturing, processing, or construction component. No EIA is required at formation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable. There are no wastewater, VOC, or stack-emission discharge points in software-only publishing. To the extent the company later handles e-waste or physical printed materials, Belize Environmental Protection Act standards and customs-controlled waste disposal rules apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification, structural load inspection, and workplace occupational clearance are not required for a virtual-only IBC without a physical operation. If a physical office or fulfillment space is subsequently established, the National Fire Service, Belize Building Authority, and Labour Department require separate inspection and clearance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Belize Tax Service (BTS), Ministry of Finance, Economic Development and Investment; official e-portal: https://www.belizetaxservice.gov.bz (e-filing via BTS eServices). IBC incorporation and annual filings: International Financial Services Commission (IFSC), https://www.ifsc.gov.bz. Physical exports: Belize Customs and Excise Department (ASYCUDA World).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1. Appoint a licensed Belize registered agent (mandatory under the IBC Act, Cap. 270). 2. File incorporation documents with the IFSC; obtain IFSC Certificate of Incorporation, which serves as evidence of automatic statutory tax exemption. 3. Obtain a BTS-issued TIN only where a bank or platform counterparty requires a tax number; no statutory obligation exists because the IBC derives no Belize-source income and falls outside the VAT net. 4. Maintain registered office and registered agent in Belize. 5. File no income-tax or VAT returns; pay only the annual IFSC license fee (USD 100–1,000 by authorized share capital). 6. If the publishing model comprises IP-related relevant activity, also comply with the Economic Substance Act (2021): Belize management, economic presence, and annual substance notification/report to the IFSC.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — A Belize IBC is a separate legal person but is statutorily exempt from income tax, business tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, stamp duty, and exchange control on all foreign-source and offshore business. Non-Belize business is deemed by statute to be conducted outside Belize. The exemption is automatic (no ruling) but is forfeited if the IBC transacts with Belize residents or owns Belize land.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Belize has no check-the-box, CFI, fiscal-transparent election, or hybrid-mismatch regime for IBCs; exemption is mandatory and automatic under the IBC Act. Voluntary conversion into a domestic company under the Companies Act is the only elective route to become a taxable Belize resident (25% corporate income tax plus business tax), which is commercially unattractive for an offshore publisher.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the VAT Act, 2005, as amended; no separate GST or sales/use tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: BZD 75,000 annual taxable turnover (approx. USD 37,500). An IBC publishing through Steam/PlayStation makes no Belize taxable supplies because the digital services are supplied to non-residents located outside Belize; VAT registration is therefore neither triggered nor available.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoice clearance, digital stamping, or B2B API mandate exists in Belize. VAT returns are filed electronically through BTS eServices on a monthly/quarterly basis; exporters retain supporting commercial records. Customs uses ASYCUDA World for physical trade declarations.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Belize VAT zero-rates exported goods and services supplied to a person who is not resident in Belize and is outside Belize at the time of supply (VAT Act, Schedule II). For a Belize IBC publishing digital games via Valve and PlayStation Store, the supply is deemed to occur at the consumer's location; accordingly, the supply falls outside Belizean VAT entirely, and no zero-rating claim, VAT refund, or input-tax credit mechanism is engaged. A domestic Belize exporter claiming zero-rating must evidence export within the statutory period to avoid reassessment.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Not applicable to digital downloads: no physical customs export declaration, bill of lading, or inward remittance certificate arises for Steam/PlayStation digital supply chains.
Digital distribution agreement between the IBC and Valve Corporation (Steam) / PlayStation Store operator evidencing platform payout terms.
Platform settlement and royalty statements (monthly/quarterly revenue reports from Steam and PlayStation Store).
IP ownership and licensing records for the game catalogue (copyright registrations and assignment agreements).
Bank statements showing foreign-currency payouts credited to the IBC account; no exchange-control filing is required as IBCs are exempt from Belize exchange control.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT clawback can arise because no Belize zero-rating is claimed by an IBC. The material exposure is IBC-status forfeiture: transacting with Belize residents or holding Belize land voids the statutory exemption, exposing the company to 25% corporate income tax, potential retrospective assessment, and IFSC strike-off. Fraudulent VAT evasion by a registered person attracts a fine of up to BZD 50,000 and/or imprisonment of up to 3 years, plus a 20% civil penalty and statutory interest. Economic substance non-compliance can additionally trigger penalties and strike-off under the Economic Substance Act (2021).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Belize (CBB), acting under the Central Bank of Belize Act (Cap. 262). The CBB is the monetary authority, administrator of the Exchange Control Act (Cap. 25), and licensing/supervisory authority for all deposit-taking banks in Belize. The International Financial Services Commission (IFSC) separately regulates IBC formation, registered agents, and beneficial-ownership filings.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Belize dollar (BZD) is pegged at the statutory parity of BZD 2.00 = USD 1.00, maintained by the CBB's reserves and the authorized-dealer banking network. Current account: fully convertible for trade in goods and services, royalties, and digital-platform settlements; no prior CBB licence, currency surcharge, or repatriation permit applies. Capital account: resident persons must route outward capital through authorized dealers and, in specified transactions, require CBB approval; however, an International Business Company is statutorily outside the exchange-control system because the IBC Act (Cap. 270), s. 6, disapplies the Exchange Control Act for IBCs. The IBC may therefore freely open foreign-currency accounts, borrow, lend, invest, guarantee, and repatriate capital without CBB approval. Profit remittance: zero statutory hurdles - no dividend withholding tax, no exchange-control permit, no minimum reinvestment rule, and no reporting obligation on distributions to non-resident shareholders.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: General resident exporters are subject to the Exchange Control Act (Cap. 25) and CBB notices requiring export proceeds to be routed through authorized dealers within prescribed timelines; the IBC, however, is wholly exempt under Cap. 270, s. 6, so no surrender timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no CBB notification apply. Steam and PlayStation digital-store receipts, being export-equivalent proceeds of the software-publishing business, may be retained indefinitely in a USD account in Belize or abroad, converted to BZD at the fixed 2:1 peg only when local operating funds are needed, or repatriated to shareholders. The only continuing regulatory duties are timely IFSC beneficial-ownership register maintenance and, where applicable, annual economic-substance filings.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Account (multi-currency, internet-enabled); Capital Escrow Account available on request
Operational USD/BZD Account with treasury desk; segregated Escrow sub-account supported
Offshore Operational USD Account - IBC and private-client fiduciary class
Offshore USD Operational Account (remote onboarding); no statutory capital escrow for IBCs

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual IBC License Fee (annual government renewal fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR), Registrar of International Business Companies, Ministry of Finance, Belize
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the anniversary of incorporation each calendar year; payment is accepted within a 30-day grace period after the anniversary without penalty
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A 10% late-payment penalty applies immediately after the 30-day grace period and compounds with continued delinquency; failure to pay the annual license fee for 12 consecutive months permits the Registrar to initiate administrative strike-off after published gazette notice, with reinstatement requiring payment of all arrears, penalties, and restoration fees

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (corporate declaration of officers, members, and registered agent details)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR), Registrar of International Business Companies, Belize
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after the anniversary of incorporation; must be filed together with the annual license fee payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing subjects the company to a statutory default penalty up to BZ$200 (US$100) per month of delay; sustained non-filing beyond one year exposes the IBC to administrative strike-off and suspension of the limited liability shield until the return is filed and the company is restored

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic Substance Notification / Economic Substance Annual Return (confirmation of relevant-activity status)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Belize International Financial Services Commission (IFSC), Economic Substance Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 12 months after the close of the accounting reference period (fiscal year-end); filed annually on the IFSC online portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or false declaration triggers fixed penalties up to BZ$25,000 plus daily default fines; severe or prolonged infringement may incur penalties up to BZ$250,000, administrative strike-off, and automatic exchange of information with tax authorities of the shareholder's jurisdiction of residence

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Financial Statements (conditional filing for IBCs exceeding asset threshold or with Belize operations)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR), Registrar of International Business Companies, Belize
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after completion of the independent audit and in all cases within 12 months after the fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Default penalties under the Belize IBC Act on the company and director/officer; persistent failure to file exposes the IBC to strike-off proceedings and disqualification of directors from acting in Belize-incorporated companies

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An independent statutory audit is compulsory where total gross assets exceed US$1,000,000 (approximately BZ$2,000,000); where the IBC carries on active business in Belize; where the IBC holds freehold or leasehold property in Belize; or where the Belize IBC Act (2023 Amendment) otherwise mandates audited financial statements. The audit must be performed by a licensed auditor acceptable to the Registrar of International Business Companies.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), with IFRS for SMEs available for qualifying private small and medium entities; no separate local Belize GAAP applies to International Business Companies

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The IBC must maintain a current Register of Significant Controllers (UBO register) at its Belize registered office. At each annual renewal the registered agent performs an updated client due diligence refresh and obtains a written beneficial-ownership confirmation from the directors or members. Any share transfer or change in significant control must be entered in the UBO and members registers within 14 days and be evidenced by a board resolution, transfer instrument, and updated register entries. The registers are confidential, are not filed in any public registry, and are disclosed only to Belize competent authorities upon lawful demand.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book (Board and Member Resolution Records)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Belize International Business Company (IBC) is wholly exempt from corporate income tax, business tax, and capital gains tax under the International Business Companies Act (Cap. 270), s.6(1). The 0% rate applies to worldwide profits, including Steam and PlayStation Store publishing revenue, provided the IBC does not carry on business with residents of Belize and does not derive income from local Belize activity.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory 50-year tax holiday running from the date of incorporation, non-extendable but restartable only by formation of a new IBC. The exemption covers income tax, corporation tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty, gift tax, estate duty, inheritance tax, and all withholding taxes. No exchange control restrictions apply. An IBC may, at its sole option, irrevocably elect to be taxed under the Income and Business Tax Act (Cap. 55) at 50% of the statutory corporate rate (effective 12.5%) in order to obtain a Belize tax residence certificate; this election is commercially destructive for a digital publisher and is not recommended.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IBC Annual Return (Form 9) under s.125 of the International Business Companies Act (Cap. 270) — filed electronically through the Belize Companies Registry portal operated by the Registrar of International Business Companies; lodgement is executed exclusively by the licensed Belize registered agent. This is a registry compliance filing, not an income tax return; the IBC files no CIT return with the Income Tax Department.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three (3) calendar months after each anniversary of the date of incorporation. Example: an IBC incorporated on 15 June files its Annual Return on or before 15 September of each year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the IBC and its unique registration number as stated on the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be an exact match to the English-language certificate; no Belize tax identification number is required because the IBC is outside the charge to income tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Belize and the name of the licensed registered agent responsible for the filing.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered office must be a physical Belize address maintained by the agent; non-resident directors should send executed board resolutions to the agent at least 10 business days before the deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital, currency denomination, par value, and classes of shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The default band is US$50,000 or 50,000 shares; the annual licence fee is computed entirely from this field, so capital overfunding creates cost with no tax benefit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Issued shares and aggregate paid-up capital expressed in the currency of the Memorandum.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Shares issued for non-cash consideration (assignment of video game copyrights) must be disclosed with the directors' written valuation; US$0 paid-up capital is lawful.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and service addresses of directors and shareholders.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Service addresses suffice for the registry; the underlying beneficial ownership data must reconcile with the separate Beneficial Ownership Register maintained under the Beneficial Ownership Act, 2019.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of compliance: no local Belize business, no local real property other than a permitted lease, and no commercial dealings with Belize residents.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Steam and PlayStation Store publishing does not constitute Belize local business if no Belizean consumers or counterparties are solicited; the declaration will be tested against the economic substance return.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing within 3 months of the anniversary: fixed penalty of BZ$50.00; filing more than 3 months late: penalty of BZ$100.00 and immediate risk of administrative strike-off without further notice. Strike-off forfeits the company's ability to receive Steam/Valve and PlayStation payouts, voids pending distribution rights, and restoration requires court application, arrears settlement, and additional court costs.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Government Licence Fee (s.126 IBC Act) — assessed and collected by the Registrar of International Business Companies using the statutory tariff schedule; remitted by the registered agent in US Dollars through the Companies Registry portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the day immediately preceding the anniversary of incorporation in each year. Fees are prorated in the year of incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized capital not exceeding US$50,000 (or 50,000 shares): annual government fee of US$100.00.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Standard band for the Steam/PlayStation publisher; adequate for the company to hold publishing receivables and pay a nominal dividend flow.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized capital between US$50,001 and US$1,000,000 (or 50,001–1,000,000 shares): annual fee of US$350.00 to US$1,000.00.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Choose the band strictly matching the Memorandum; a higher band does not improve bankability and increases the annual compliance wallet.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Unpaid fee accrues a surcharge of 10% per month or part-month of default; after 3 months of non-payment the Registrar may strike off the company without additional notification. A struck-off IBC loses legal standing to sue Valve or Sony for unpaid platform receivables.
